Results.ReviewText: After my 40 year old 22" Weber kettle (that belonged to my Grandfather) finally gave out I got the 22" Original Kettle Premium. I couldn't be happier. I'm learning so many new techniques on the world's best grill. I love my Weber
Results.Title: World's Best

Results.ReviewText: Webers are the grills that get the job done. I've been using Webers for 50 years and we always have a great bbq. I love the 22 inch size...the flip in grill ends, the ash catcher, the vent lever and the built in thermometer in the lid. Great product!
Results.Title: The BBQ Master Grill

Results.ReviewText: I now remember why the Webber Kettle is a classic original. Highly versatile and maximum flavor. Looking forward to trying all the different cooking methods you can do on the kettle.
Results.Title: Original Classic

Results.ReviewText: This Kettle drum barbecue is a great addition to our Weber gas grill. We love the taste od the charcoaled steak and fresh caught flounder. Its very easy to assemble and the safety mechanisms built in are a real plus.
Results.Title: Well Worth the Purchase!

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and the meals prepared on this charcoal grill so far have been exceptional!!!
Results.Title: Wonderful Product

Results.ReviewText: There's a reason Weber is number 1. I already own a Weber Genesis gas grill but I really missed the smell and taste when you grill over charcoal. So, I went back to basics. There was no question that I was purchasing a kettle grill from Weber. The grill is super easy to use and maintain.
Results.Title: Love My Weber!!!

Results.ReviewText:
We love the smoky flavor charcoal gives. It really enhances the flavor of meat, fish and vegetables. 
I have tried pellet grills, yes plural and other charcoal grills that cost me more than 8 times as much as this Webber and one especially (the egg) cooked really nice, but I really like the simplicity, the flexibility in how you direct the heat & temperature and the on hands way you use this grill so I am happy I went back to the Webber Kettle. 
Nothing to break the day you invite friends over for some Ribeyes like my LAST pellet grill, easy to start without starter fluid ( get the chimney starter) any temp you want where you want and for as long as you want it. 
Couldn’t ask for much more from a grill 
And great customer service too boot!
Results.Title: Back to the Basics and Happy Grilling Again

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill….gave it to my boyfriend for his birthday and he loves it. He even grilled pizza on it!
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: Love it.  Best quality and best charcoal grill I've ever owned
Results.Title: Love It!

Results.ReviewText: It’s definitely worth the money. I don’t have any complaints.
Results.Title: The best kettle grill on the market.

Results.ReviewText: It's the king for a reason. Out of all the grills I own, from big green expensives to propane griddles to smokers, the one that will always remain is a standard Weber Kettle. Always. It's versatile, tough, won't break the bank and I love cooking on them. From Smokey Joe's all the way up the ladder, they're the best.
Results.Title: Nothing Beats the Original

Results.ReviewText: I owned a base model Weber Kettle about 30 years ago. I've had a couple of gas grills since then and I just never liked them as much as I liked my charcoal grill. I wasn't any good with it, but I had no interest in getting better with a gas grill. I bought a new Premium model grill in Copper color, and I have also read Weber's "The Art of the Grill," which really inspired me to get a lot better. The book broke things down for me and I've watched a lot of YouTube videos. But the recipes in the book are what make me want to get better. So, I bought 120lbs of charcoal from Sam's and I've used about half of it since buying my grill a few weeks ago!
Results.Title: I missed my kettle - a lot.

Results.ReviewText: Best way to grill! Perfect temperature control, and charcoal gives the finished product a much better taste than gas provided heat. Weber is the only choice when choosing a charcoal grill. Also, less cleanup than gas grills.
Results.Title: The best choice in charcoal grills!

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber Kettle Grill.  I use both a gas grill and a charcoal grill. I use the charcoal mainly for indirect, slow cooking. I have learned to use the vents on the grill to control the temperature which is the key to cooking with charcoal. The high quality of the Weber Kettle Grill will give me many years for trouble free grilling. Weber makes the best grills.
Results.Title: Happy with our Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: As a longtime owner of the "Kettle", this product is easier than the older models.  Ash management and ventilation/fire control is so much easier.  The cooking process is pretty hard to beat.
Results.Title: Worth Buying

Results.ReviewText: Excellent Grill! The size is perfect for one or two people. I can cook a lot of food with this grill. So easy to clean up afterwards and doesn’t take up a lot of space! Love my webber!
Results.Title: Perfect size!

Results.ReviewText: I have wanted a Weber Kettle for many years, My Wife purchased this for me for an early Father's day gift. Ive used ot 2 times aleday and I love it. Mine is the 22inch, and it holds at any temperature I want. Its perfect I highly recommend this to anyone,  a beginner or a pro.
Results.Title: Hands down is worh the money

Results.ReviewText: Great product that consistently performs well. Well balanced and attractive looking. My daughter purchased the gold one for me for Mothers Day. Later I purchased the grill cover and glad I did since the weather has been terrible here. I thank her everyday for this gift. Love it👍
Results.Title: Gift from Daughter

Results.ReviewText: The kettle makes the best food, Better than any other grill!
Results.Title: I have told all of my friends.

Results.ReviewText: This is my replacement for my original weber mastertouch from 1993.  The wooden handles had burnt off, a hole had finally rusted through prompting the replacement.  I had rebuilt it 3 times over the years.  It was my father's day present that year.  A lot of memories were created with that old kettle.  I used my rotisserie with that old kettle every Thanksgiving and Christmas for the holiday turkey.  I needed another kettle to continue that tradition.  I got my son a kettle and rotisserie many years ago and he has continued that same tradition with his family.
Results.Title: Family traditions

Results.ReviewText: I have had Webber grills for 30yrs Our new one came and I had to put it together no easy task the instructions were hard to follow when I was done and went to put the top lid on the grill it would not fit    either the grill itself or the lid were bent.I was not up to taking it apart and trying to put it back in the box and ship it back.For 269 dollars I expected better We have only used it once and had such a bad time trying to use the lit part of the grill I am not sure what to do with it.
Results.Title: Defected Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the versatility and different methods of cooking. From quick sear to low and slow. Plenty of grilling surface, too. We use it at our seasonal campsite where sometimes you need to grill burgers and dogs at the same time.
Results.Title: Perfect campsite grill

Results.ReviewText: Second Weber kettle I’ve owned and always enjoyed the charcoal flavored foods. Also own a Genesis for when in a hurry to cook
Results.Title: Great Kettle

Results.ReviewText: I love slowing down to enjoy the cook.  I’m getting back in to charcoal vs wood pellets
Results.Title: Slow down to enjoy grilling vs using an easy bake

Results.ReviewText: Excellent quality and design. This is our 3rd Weber and Weber always makes improvements for the consumer.
Results.Title: Weber is number one!

Results.ReviewText: It works as well as the old one, and has sensible modifications that make life easier.
Results.Title: Works well

Results.ReviewText:
My new Webber grill performs very well as all my previous ones have!
My one complaint is that the ash catcher bowl is flimsy and difficult to keep together.  This feature just doesn’t seem to have the same quality as my previous Webbers.
I am still rating this grill 4 stars because of its cooking performance.
Results.Title: Quality of manufacturing and performance

Results.ReviewText: I have owned quite a few grills through the years and currently have five. This kettle is hands down the best I’ve cooked on. It is very easy to regulate the temp during long indirect cooks and add fuel as needed. My second cook on it was a pork butt, which had much better flavor and had a better bark than I can get with a pellet grill.
Results.Title: Best Grill I’ve Owned

Results.ReviewText: i bought this grill about 2 months ago replacing a Weber Kettle grill I had for about 8 years. This would be a 5 star review except for 1 feature. The ash catcher is extremely difficult to remove and replace. The instruction video is extremely deceiving. I need a pair of pliers to squeeze the handle tight enough to remove the catcher. Terrible design.
Results.Title: One bad feature

Results.ReviewText: Bought on 5/20/24.  Assembled & 1st cook (chicken) on the 23rd.  Cooked another spatchcock chicken on the 25th & a 5 minute sear cook of marinated skirt steak on the 26th. On the 27th I tried opening the top vent. It wouldn't open because the paint had melted under the steel vent adjuster. Had to use a rubber mallet to open it. Called Weber. They said to communicate via email.  Sent them email with pics.  2 days later they responded that I needed to re-send pics in another format & they might send me a new lid. I took the lid to Lowes & they agreed to full refund & they'd take it back even w/o a box.  Lowes gave me a new upgraded bbq as an even swap for my trouble.  Terrible service by Weber & then they sent me an email after I told them I returned it.  Email said they "solved" the "problem"!
Results.Title: Paint bubbled after 3 cooks

Results.ReviewText: The bowl on my Weber grill developed a burn through hole. My friend suggested placing a warranty claim. The process was easy and was addressed quickly. Extremely helpful through the process. This was a surprising but satisfying experience. I have used Weber products for years. Glad they do stand behind their products
Results.Title: Warranty

Results.ReviewText: Great grill that holds temperature and easy to use
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. Super easy to use and the food is so delicious!
Results.Title: Love this Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is probably my 5th. Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill and it continues to be the best kettle type grill I've used.  I've added the charcoal trays which makes indirect cooking easier.  The one touch vent and ash catch make cleaning the grill easy and without a mess.
Results.Title: Best kettle grill on the market

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber kettle since 2005. The first kettle was lost in move. Has done exactly as needed, and saved me money. Has endured what so many cannot. Sets a standard in achievement. Thx.
Results.Title: Replaces all simply, effortlessly, and economical.

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us. Our Care Team will follow up to make sure this has been resolved. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Weber left off one of the body handles, making it difficult to lift or maneuver the grill. Big mistake.
Results.Title: Now only one body handle

Results.ReviewText: I had one of these and sold it maybe 10 years ago. Bought a new one today, did a spatchcock chicken. Was like never switched grills. Came out perfect. Was like never missed a beat. We like charcoal, switched to pellet. Now we're back...
Results.Title: It's the same as I remembered.

Results.ReviewText: After years with the original 22… stepped up to the premium 22 seems more heavy duty so hoping to have it longer still cooks just as well as the other one can’t wait to get some accessories and really open up the possibilities
Results.Title: New premium 22 kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Kettle grill and my first with the built-in thermometer. My wife prefers a charcoal grill over a gas grill. Plenty of surface space as I recently grilled a dozen burgers along with 10 brats at the same time. I’ve used my older grill as a smoker as well and plan to do the same with this one.
Results.Title: Great versatile charcoal grill.

Results.ReviewText: I always grew up owning a weber grill and they last forever! Thats the reason why i own one now and still always satisfied with the different type of cooks you can do on a weber.
Results.Title: My new grill

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
